# 1 Enoch Chapter 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**27:1** Then Uriel, one of the holy-angels who was with me, answered and said: "This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever; here shall all the accursed be assembled who utter with their lips against the Lord unseeming words and of his glory speak hard things. Here shall they be assembled, and here shall be their place of judgment.

**27:2** "And in the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgment in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of glory, the Eternal King.

**27:3** "And in the days of judgment over the former [they shall bless him] for the mercy in accordance with which he has assigned them [their lot]."

**27:4** Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and set forth his glory and praised him gloriously.

**27:5** And from thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain-range of the desert; and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar. Ch. 27 provides Uriel's interpretation of the accursed valley: it is the place of eternal condemnation for blasphemers (Gehenna). The righteous will witness the judgment of the wicked (vv. 2-3). V. 5 transitions to the second cosmic journey (chs. 28-36). Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
